chapters.title: Build a deck
chapters.text: Start from a ready-made deck, or create your own in a minute.

chapters.title: Run a session
chapters.text: Individual: everyone plays solo. Groups: teams of 3 with one representative. Add a time limit if you like.

chapters.title: Reveal & celebrate
chapters.text: See how the room voted, then hit Reveal. Discuss what gave it away.
